sample_unit: virtual patients (Monte Carlo simulated); number analyzed not reported

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT nutritional analysis (calories, protein, minerals) versus USDA-approved software
links.effect: Dietitian rated nutritional analysis 2/5; ChatGPT underestimated calories by 36%, protein 28%, fat 48%, phosphorus 54%, potassium 49%, sodium 53%.
links.quote: ChatGPT's nutritional analysis underestimated calories by 36% (95% CI: 44-88%), protein by 28% (25-167%), fat 48% (29-81%), phosphorus 54% (15-102%), potassium 49% (40-68%), and sodium 53% (14-139%).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4's ability to generate nutritional advice and meal plans for simulated dialysis patients, assessed by a renal dietitian.
